CONVEYOR SYSTEM PROBLEMS/CAUSES AND THEIR SOLUTIONS

symptom: Belt runs to one side for long distance or entire length of conveyor.

causes.cause: Belt running off-center around the tail pulley and through the loading area
actions: install training idlers on the return run prior to tail pulley.
adjust chute to place load on center of belt
discharge material in direction of belt travel at or near belt speed.
improve maintenance. Install scrapers or other cleaning devices.

causes.cause: Idlers or pulleys out-of square with center line of belt
